## Description

_At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive._

#### Responsibilities:

- Design, develop, deploy, monitor, operate and maintain existing or new elements of our systems and infrastructure.
- Collaborate with engineers and partners in science & product to drive projects from inception, specification, execution, to launch.
- Write well-crafted, well-tested, readable, and maintainable code.
- Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and distribute knowledge.
- Build an extensible and scalable platform that powers secure detection and response capabilities across the security lifecycle.
- Ensure high availability and reliability of detection engineering systems to support critical security monitoring and threat identification flows.

#### Experience:

- Master’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
- 2 years of pre- or post-academic experience in job offered, software development, or related occupation.
- Experience with Object-oriented programming.
- Experience writing clear, scalable, and clear design documentation.
- Experience with backend software development of large-scale distributed systems.

#### Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
- Mental health benefits
- Family building benefits
- Child care and pet benefits
- 401(k) plan to help save for your future
- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
- Subsidized commuter benefits
- Lyft Pink - Lyft team members get an exclusive opportunity to test new benefits of our Ridership Program
